name: Pioneer Investcorp Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1984, Pioneer Investcorp Ltd 
is in the business of providing Financial Services
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a SEBI registered Category–I Merchant Banker  and an integrated mid-market focused financial services company. It provides Investment Banking and Financial Advisory Services which includes formulating capital structure, raising capital, debt restructuring, project financing, coal consultancy and other corporate advisory services. Apart from this, company also deals  in Secondary capital market like open offer in Takeovers, Right issue, Buyback, Mergers and Amalgamation, and valuation assignments, Government securities (G-Sec & SDL) and corporate bonds

pros: Stock is trading at 0.66 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 20.5% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.75% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.23% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 43.6% of their holding.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.10.4 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 1,043 days.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
